scope: Full source obligations plus first seven bounded native probes; NOT a full qualification matrix.
original_lines: parse/main 850-1030; state/worker/autocalibration reviewed in full source

obligations.original: Required recursive BMP/BMP directory, natural order; n>0 truncates file list before cycling.
obligations.current_gap: Adapter does not truncate source list before state-driven image-count increase.
Adapter rejects q0/q101; historical invalid-quality case is a subset mismatch, not native parity.

obligations.original: -d downloads; -o implies download+write; neither keeps encoded payload on device.
obligations.current_gap: Adapter always downloads and creates/removes a temporary file.

obligations.original: Absent -j calibrates throughput; -j0 hardware_concurrency; user -j positive is fixed.
obligations.current_gap: Adapter uses min(2,image count), with no calibration.

obligations.original: n clamped >=0, r>=1, s>=0; auto states=max(1,engines*2,threads); images>=states.
obligations.current_gap: Adapter rejects negative n/r and imposes undocumented fixed caps. Lifecycle still per-call.

obligations.original: AUTO enables available GPU/hardware; -b gpu,hardware or both. Report actual engines.
obligations.current_gap: AMD software GPU mapped; forced NVIDIA-only hardware capability remains unavailable and must be explicit.

obligations.original: State-local streams and two image buffers; overlapping transfer and encode; single-input preallocation.
obligations.current_gap: Adapter has rotating streams but synchronous encode, per-image allocation and pageable host buffers.
Pixel chain/entropy implemented; lifetime, large-scale guards and production prefix still owed.

obligations.original: No args or -h anywhere prints usage. Missing input and negative states fail.
obligations.current_gap: Adapter only handles standalone -h; corrupt BMP and allocation-failure cleanup need complete verification.

acceptance.pixel_tolerance: Not frozen yet: native pilot is observation only; freeze independent retained set before final candidate qualification.
